info.title: OMA LwM2M Edge Application Server Configuration (Object ID 10378)

Edge_Application_Server_Configuration.label: Edge Application Server Configuration
Edge_Application_Server_Configuration.description: This is used for UE to obtain information about suitable Edge Application Server in Edge Data Network, and to support service continuity for the UE to minimize service interruption.

Application_Client_ID.label: Application Client ID
Application_Client_ID.description: Identity of the Application Client used to distinguish multiple ACs if applicable, refer to [3GPP TS 23.558].

EAS_ID.label: EAS ID
EAS_ID.description: The identifier of the Edge Application Server, refer to [3GPP TS 23.558].

EAS_Endpoint.label: EAS Endpoint
EAS_Endpoint.description: The endpoint information (e.g. URI, FQDN, IP address) used to communicate with the Edge Application Server, refer to [3GPP TS 23.558].

Type.label: Type
Type.description:
Type of EAS that may be useful in service continuity scenario. UE may switch from source EAS (S-EAS) to target EAS (T-EAS) during mobility.
1: S-EAS
2: T-EAS
refer to [3GPP TS 23.558]
